Restaurant suite: QR menu, kitchen display, delivery

Guests order and pay by QR at the table, the order appears on the kitchen screen, and there is less waiting and fewer mistakes. Qilich builds the MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 108 mln; the full version in 14–24 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • QR menu with photos in three languages
  • Table ordering
  • Click or Payme payment and tips
  • Kitchen display
  • Integration with your POS (iiko or R-Keeper)
What the full version adds
  • Own delivery with Telegram ordering and couriers
  • Aggregator orders (Yandex Eats, Uzum Tezkor) on one screen
  • Loyalty
  • Table booking
  • Food cost and stock
  • Owner dashboard

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today and sample documents
  • Existing data: Excel or an old system
  • Staff to try the system
  • One person who makes the decisions
